name: dsh-omni-vision
description: Visual I/O for the DSH Web GUI: eyes_grab captures the screen (window/screen/region) and hands the picture straight to the model without leaving a file, eyes_render draws on a canvas (text, arrows, paths, arcs, function plots y=f(x), parametric curves x(t),y(t), labeled coordinate grids, Mermaid) that the model can see again and whose PNG is kept as one permanent copy under pics/, eyes_paste brings a user image into the conversation. Windows-only companions: eyes_ocr (Windows.Media.Ocr), eyes_analyze (pixel grid). Nothing transient is written into the workspace.
